description: This file defines the interface for TemplateDomainService, providing methods for managing Template entities such as retrieving, creating, updating, and removing templates within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: TemplateDomainService
classes.description: Interface providing domain-driven methods for handling Template entities, including retrieval, creation, updating, and deletion.

methods.name: getAllByEntityAndType
methods.description: Retrieves all templates filtered by a specific entity and type.

methods.name: findOneById
methods.description: Finds a single Template by its unique identifier.

methods.name: createTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new Template using the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateTemplate
methods.description: Updates a Template specified by ID with data from the JsonCommand.

methods.name: removeTemplate
methods.description: Removes the Template identified by its ID.
